# Examples

The examples in this repository are small programs you can run against your own osu!lazer data. Their source files also contain the text shown in this guide.

## Running an example

```sh
cd examples/<name>
npm install
npm start
```

## Available examples

- [Beatmaps](/guide/examples/beatmaps) - Create, inspect, import, and export beatmaps and their storyboards.
- [Collections](/guide/examples/collections) - Import, export, and edit the beatmap collections stored in Realm.
- [Replays](/guide/examples/replays) - Import `.osr` files into Realm or export stored scores as replay files.
- [Skins](/guide/examples/skins) - Import `.osk` archives into Realm or pack installed skins back into archives.
- [Keybindings](/guide/examples/keybindings) - Register the osu! defaults, inspect an action, and replace its assigned keys.
